EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Clinical Trial Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a structured schema for clinical trial snapshot including phase, status, summary, eligibility criteria, locations, and URL. Ensure alignment with existing ClinicalTrials.gov response fields and Pydantic validation models, including explicit handling of optional/missing fields.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Clinical Trial Snapshot Extraction and Normalization Logic
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S2.description: Extend clinical_trials_service to extract required attributes (phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, URL) from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses and normalize them into the defined schema, including robust handling of missing, inconsistent, or multi-location data.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Clinical Trial Snapshot via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S3.description: Integrate normalized clinical trial snapshot into evaluate_care_facade so that trial data is returned in a consistent, structured format to the frontend chat experience, preserving ordering and readability.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S4.title: Frontend Rendering of Clinical Trial Snapshot with Safe Links
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S4.description: Render clinical trial snapshot data in chat UI using structured formatting (phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, URL) and ensure URLs are safely rendered and validated via existing markdown and URL handling mechanisms.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trial Snapshot Flow
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S5.description: Create unit tests for extraction and normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov API response through service and facade layers, including edge cases for missing fields and invalid URLs.
